build_ultrafeedback_prompt_dataset: build a script to process the UltraFeedback dataset into prompt-only conversational format
create_script_arguments: create a ScriptArguments dataclass with push_to_hub, repo_id, and dataset_num_proc fields
run_transform_unpaired_preference: run to_unpaired_preference to convert UltraFeedback instructions into unpaired prompt format
run_filter_long_prompts: run drop_long_prompt to filter out prompts longer than 512 characters
run_push_to_hub: run the script with push_to_hub to upload the processed dataset to the Hugging Face Hub
